articles.title: The Narrow Space Between Two Lines
articles.summary: A patient's dose remains unchanged while the body's clearance slows, and yesterday's suitable exposure quietly crosses the upper line today.
articles.summaryZh: 病人的药量没有改变，身体清除药物的速度却变慢，昨日合适的暴露在今日悄悄越过了上面那条线。
storyParagraphs: Uncle Lin had long used a medicine requiring careful monitoring. Too little exposure might not provide sufficient effect, while too much could cause serious harm, with only a narrow range between them. He remained stable for years on one regimen and assumed the space would never move.

After an acute illness, Lin continued the same regimen but developed unusual fatigue and unsteadiness. Thinking his original condition had worsened, he considered taking more. The pharmacist told him not to change it himself and reviewed recent illness, liver and kidney function, other medicines, timing, and test results. Slower clearance had made the same dose produce greater exposure.

The clinical team adjusted the plan using symptoms, indication, and concentrations measured at appropriate times, with continued review. Upper and lower lines were not permanent walls for every person. Drug, purpose, age, physiological change, measurement error, and interactions could alter the position between benefit and toxicity, and some effects could not be judged from one concentration alone.

Lin left hospital only after becoming stable. The pharmacist did not give him a range to explore up and down by himself. The card stated a fixed regimen, monitoring date, changes to report, and the responsible team. A narrow range required closer professional management, not self-directed balancing by symptoms.
Before going home, Lin removed an old note from the medicine box that read, 'Take one more if you feel unwell.' The new card held only the next review time and clinic telephone number.
storyParagraphsZh: 林叔长期使用一种需要谨慎监测的药。剂量太低时难以获得足够作用，暴露过高又可能出现严重不良反应，两者之间只隔着不宽的范围。多年里，他在固定方案下很稳定，便以为那一格永远不会移动。
一次急病后，林叔仍按原方案用药，却开始出现异常乏力和步态不稳。他以为原病加重，想再多用一些。药师先让他不要自行改变，核对新近疾病、肝肾功能、其他药物、用药时间和检测结果，发现身体清除速度已经变慢，相同剂量造成了更高暴露。
临床团队根据症状、适应证和合适时点的浓度监测调整方案，并持续复查。图上的上下界不是对每个人永远固定的墙：药物、用途、年龄、生理变化、测量误差和相互作用都可能改变获益与毒性之间的位置；有些效果也不能只靠一次浓度判断。
林叔稳定后才出院。药师没有给他一张可以自己上下试探的范围，而是写清固定方案、监测日期、需要报告的变化和负责团队。窄范围要求更密切的专业管理，不是鼓励患者凭感觉在两条线之间走钢丝。
回家前，林叔把原先写着‘不舒服就加一片’的便签从药盒上撕下。新的卡片只有下一次复查时间和诊所电话。
explanationParagraphs: A therapeutic window is the range of dose or exposure expected to provide sufficient benefit while avoiding unacceptable toxicity. Its width and position depend on the drug, purpose, individual physiology, interactions, measurement, and clinical context. Small exposure changes can affect efficacy or safety for a narrow-window medicine. It guides professional dosing and monitoring; it is not permission for self-adjustment.
explanationParagraphsZh: 治疗窗是药物剂量或暴露预计能提供足够获益、又避免不可接受毒性的区间。它的宽度和位置取决于药物、用途、个体生理、相互作用、测量与临床情境；窄治疗窗药物的小幅暴露变化可能影响疗效或安全。它是专业给药和监测概念，不是患者自行调整剂量的许可范围。

articles.title: Two Journeys of the Same Tablet
articles.titleZh: 同一颗药走过的两条路
articles.summary: The same tablet is taken at the same hour, but an altered body keeps it longer, so the previous dose remains when the next arrives.
articles.summaryZh: 同样一颗药、同样一个时刻服下，病后归来的身体却让它停得更久，下一颗到来时，上一颗还没有离开。
storyParagraphs: Mrs Xu had taken the same medicine on schedule for years. After recovering from a hospital admission, she resumed morning and evening use but became increasingly drowsy. Her family checked the box: tablet count, timing, and label were correct, so they assumed the familiar bottle could not be responsible.

A clinical pharmacist drew each administration on a timeline. Medicine first entered the body from its route of administration, distributed into tissues, underwent metabolism, and was eliminated. Changes in Mrs Xu's physiology and newly added medicines affected parts of that journey and slowed clearance. More of one administration remained when the next arrived, allowing accumulation with repetition.

The pharmacist also explained that oral, injected, and other routes differ in absorption rate and bioavailable fraction, while peak concentration and total exposure are not the same measure. A single blood result is hard to interpret without its sampling time. Age, organ function, genetics, food, and interactions can make one regimen trace different curves across people or across time in one person.

The team adjusted the plan using the treatment goal, clinical response, and monitoring and continued observation. Models supported predictions about interval, steady state, and accumulation but could not replace assessment of the patient. A medicine could not be excluded merely because its name had been unchanged for years.

Mrs Xu continued using the old medicine box after discharge. Inside its lid, the pharmacist placed a small timeline with an empty stretch after the final tablet, reminding the team to consider the medicine's route out.
storyParagraphsZh: 许太太每天按时使用同一种药，几年没有变化。住院康复后，她照旧在早晚服用，却渐渐嗜睡。家人检查药盒，颗数、时间和标签都没有错，便以为问题不可能来自这瓶熟悉的药。
临床药师把每次用药画在时间线上。药物先从给药部位进入身体，再分布到不同组织，经过代谢并被排出。许太太病后的生理状态和新增药物改变了其中一些环节，清除比从前慢；下一次用药到来时，前一次留下的量更多，重复后便逐渐积累。
药师还说明，口服、注射或其他途径的进入速度和可利用部分不同，浓度高峰与总体暴露也不是同一个数。抽血时点若不清楚，单个结果很难解释。年龄、器官功能、遗传、食物与相互作用都会让同一方案在不同人或同一人的不同时期走出不同曲线。
团队结合治疗目标、临床反应和监测调整方案，并继续观察。模型帮助预测给药间隔、稳态与积累，却不能替代面对病人的评估；出现变化时，也不能只因药名多年未换便排除药物暴露的问题。
许太太出院后仍使用那个旧药盒。药师在盒盖内侧贴了一条小时间线，最后一颗药后面留着一段空白，提醒团队去看药物离开的路。
explanationParagraphs: Pharmacokinetics describes how absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion shape drug concentration over time. Route, bioavailability, distribution volume, clearance, half-life, repeated administration, and individual physiology influence peak, total exposure, steady state, and accumulation. Models support qualified dosing and monitoring, but results require sampling time, clinical response, and individual assessment.
explanationParagraphsZh: 药代动力学描述吸收、分布、代谢和排泄怎样形成药物浓度随时间的变化。给药途径、生物利用度、分布容积、清除率、半衰期、重复给药和个体生理共同影响峰值、总体暴露、稳态与积累。模型支持合格给药和监测，但结果必须结合采样时点、临床反应与个体评估。

articles.title: Every Bottle Was Correct on Its Own
articles.summary: Three physicians prescribe reasonable medicines; every bottle is correct alone, but together in one bag they leave the patient unable to walk steadily.
articles.summaryZh: 三位医生各自开出合理的药，瓶子单独看都没有问题，放到同一只药袋里后，病人却再也走不稳。
storyParagraphs: Uncle Zhou received medicines from a heart clinic, a sleep clinic, and a pharmacy and often used an over-the-counter product for itching. Each prescriber saw a reasonable part of his care, and Zhou had not deliberately concealed anything; no one had asked him to place every bottle on one table. After a new medicine was added, he became sleepy by day and unsteady on his feet.

A pharmacist completed a full reconciliation and found more than simply too many medicines. One slowed the metabolism of another and raised exposure. Two others produced additive sedating effects through different pathways. Even without concentration change, physiological effects could add, oppose, or alter risk. Food, alcohol, illness, and supplements could also participate.

The team reviewed purpose, dose, timing, evidence, and Zhou's liver and kidney function rather than automatically stopping every pair highlighted by an online list. Some combinations could be used with adjustment or monitoring, some had to be avoided, and other warnings were mainly theoretical. Management considered the consequences of not treating; every possible interaction did not carry equal importance.

The prescribers simplified and adjusted one coordinated plan, giving Zhou a single medicine list. The pharmacy added reconciliation before each new item. Zhou was asked to report prescriptions, non-prescription products, herbs, and supplements to qualified professionals rather than assume that separating them by a few hours removed risk.
At review, Zhou brought every bottle from home in a cloth bag. The pharmacist removed them one by one, then turned the empty bag inside out to make sure no unlabelled vial remained.
storyParagraphsZh: 周伯分别在心脏门诊、睡眠门诊和药房领取药物，还常用一种非处方止痒药。每位医生看到的那一部分都合理，周伯也从未故意隐瞒，只是没人请他把所有瓶子放在同一张桌上。新药加入后，他白天嗜睡、走路摇晃。
药师进行完整核对，发现问题不只是‘药太多’。一种药减慢了另一种药的代谢，使暴露升高；另两种药则在不同途径上叠加了相似的镇静作用。即使浓度不变，生理作用也可能相加、抵消或改变风险；食物、酒精、疾病和补充剂也可能参与。
团队查看每种药的目的、剂量、时机、证据和周伯的肝肾功能，不靠一张网络清单自动停掉所有被标红的组合。有些组合在监测或调整后可以使用，有些必须避免，另一些警告只有理论依据。处理要权衡不治疗的后果，不能把‘可能相互作用’误写成相同严重程度。
几位开药者共同简化并调整方案，给周伯一份统一药单，药房也设置每次新增前的核对。周伯被提醒把处方药、非处方药、草药和补充剂都报告给合格专业人员，而不是自行错开几小时便认为风险消失。
复诊时，周伯把家里所有瓶子装进一只布袋带来。药师逐一取出，最后把空袋翻过来，确认里面没有落下一只没有标签的小瓶。
explanationParagraphs: Drug interactions occur when a medicine, food, or other substance changes another medicine's exposure through absorption, metabolism, transport, or excretion, or changes its effect through additive, opposing, or other pharmacodynamic mechanisms. Clinical importance depends on substance, dose, timing, person, purpose, and evidence. Complete medication reconciliation and professional judgement are more reliable than isolated lists or self-directed timing changes.
explanationParagraphsZh: 药物相互作用是药物、食物或其他物质通过改变吸收、代谢、转运、排泄等药代过程，或通过叠加、拮抗等药效过程，改变另一种药的暴露或作用。临床重要性取决于物质、剂量、时机、个体、用途与证据。完整用药核对和专业判断比孤立清单或自行错时服用更可靠。

articles.fieldTitle: Traditional and complementary medicine and therapy
articles.fieldTitleZh: 传统与补充医学及疗法
articles.title: Two Identical Treatment Rooms
articles.titleZh: 两间一模一样的治疗室
articles.summary: A clinic claims that a rare heated stone relieves pain; a researcher places it and an ordinary stone within the same ritual, and patients improve in both rooms.
articles.summaryZh: 疗养院声称一块稀有暖石能止痛，研究者把它和普通石头放进相同仪式里，病人却在两间房都报告改善。
storyParagraphs: A mountain clinic was famous for a 'moon-veined stone'. The practitioner listened quietly, lit a softly scented lamp, and placed a warm slice of stone on the painful area. Many people reported less pain afterward. The owner assigned all improvement to a special power in the stone and prepared to sell similar pieces at a high price.

A researcher made ordinary stones identical in appearance and temperature and assigned them randomly to two equally arranged rooms. Patients and outcome assessors did not know which stone was used. Time, care, expectation, and ritual remained the same. People improved in both groups, but the difference did not support a specific effect of the moon-veined material.

The owner replied that if ordinary stone worked too, the study proved everything imaginary. The researcher disagreed. Expectation, learning, therapeutic relationship, a reassuring environment, and ritual can alter pain experience and some responses, and those changes may be real. Natural fluctuation, regression, measurement, and concurrent care can also change before-and-after results. None alone demonstrates a specific property of the stone.

The clinic retained honesty, respect, and time to listen, but stopped inventing claims about the stone and did not use deception to create expectation. Patients received evidence and uncertainty without delay of effective care when needed. Later studies used suitable controls to separate specific effects, surrounding context, and natural change.
The owner removed the gold MOON-STONE ROOM sign from the door. The comfortable chair and long appointment remained; the stones returned to a drawer for ordinary warm compresses.
storyParagraphsZh: 山间疗养院以一块‘月纹石’闻名。治疗师会安静听病人说话，点一盏淡香灯，再把温热石片放在疼处。许多人结束时说疼痛减轻，院主便把全部改善归给石头里的特殊力量，准备高价出售同类石片。
研究者请人做出外观和温度相同的普通石片，随机放进两间布置一致的治疗室；病人和评估者不知道当天用的是哪一种。两边都保留相同时间、关怀、期待和仪式。结果两组都有人改善，差别却没有支持月纹石的特殊作用。
院主说，既然普通石也有效，研究便证明‘什么都只是想象’。研究者没有同意。期待、学习、治疗关系、安心的环境和仪式可以改变疼痛体验及某些反应，这些改变可能真实；同时，自然波动、症状回归、测量和其他照护也会让治疗前后不同。它们不能单独证明石头具有特异疗效。
疗养院保留诚实、尊重和充分倾听，却停止虚构石头成分，也不以欺骗制造期待。病人知道证据与不确定性，需要有效治疗时不会被延误。之后的研究设置合适对照，分别估计特异作用、周围情境和自然变化。
院主最后从门上取下‘月纹石室’的金字牌。房里的舒适椅子和长预约时段都留下，石片则回到普通热敷用品的抽屉。
articles.conceptNameZh: 情境效应与安慰剂效应
explanationParagraphs: Contextual and placebo effects arise from expectation, learning, meaning, relationship, communication, and ritual surrounding an intervention and can influence genuine experience and some physiological responses. Before-and-after improvement may also reflect natural history, regression to the mean, measurement, and concurrent care, so it cannot establish a treatment's specific mechanism. Suitable controls help separate effects, and supportive context can be used honestly without deception.
explanationParagraphsZh: 情境效应与安慰剂效应来自干预周围的期待、学习、意义、关系、沟通和仪式，可影响真实体验与部分生理反应。治疗前后改善还可能来自自然病程、均值回归、测量和同时照护，因此不能据此证明某种疗法的特异机制。合适对照帮助分离效应，诚实利用支持性情境也不需要欺骗。

articles.fieldTitle: Traditional and complementary medicine and therapy
articles.fieldTitleZh: 传统与补充医学及疗法
articles.title: Seven Kinds of Evidence on One Table
articles.titleZh: 同一张桌上的七份证据
articles.summary: A council asks whether a herb works and receives seven answers from seven forms of evidence because they are answering different questions.
articles.summaryZh: 议会想知道一种草药是否有效，七份证据给出七种答案，因为它们其实在回答不同问题。
storyParagraphs: The city had to decide whether to purchase silver-root herb. Seven items lay on the council table: one patient's thank-you letter, records from a hundred clinic visitors, an animal experiment, an observational comparison of users, a randomized trial, a synthesis of several studies, and an adverse-event registry. The chair wanted the highest item so he could stamp TRUE or FALSE.

A thank-you letter could identify an experience worth investigation but lacked a comparison with non-users. Clinic records were more systematic yet remained vulnerable to selection and natural recovery. A randomized trial better estimated an average specific effect, but could be small, poorly run, or exclude older patients seen in practice. For rare harms, long-term use, implementation barriers, or reasons for refusal, other designs could provide evidence the trial lacked.

The reviewer first separated the questions: which outcome might improve, for whom, against what comparison, over what time, with what harms, and whether use was feasible in this city. Each study was assessed for bias, consistency, precision, directness, and reporting rather than ranked by name alone. A badly conducted design with a prestigious label did not automatically defeat every well-conducted alternative.

The conclusion retained levels of certainty and unresolved questions. Confidence about benefit might come from a synthesis of several reliable trials; rare risks still needed registries and monitoring; patient interviews explained acceptability. Decisions would change if new research altered the body of evidence. No stone pyramid on the table could answer every kind of question forever.

After the meeting, the chair did not stack the seven items from high to low. He asked the clerk for drawers labelled BENEFIT, HARM, APPLICABILITY, and IMPLEMENTATION and placed each item where its question belonged.
storyParagraphsZh: 城里要决定是否采购银根草。议事桌上摆着七份材料：一位病人的感谢信、一家诊所的百人记录、动物实验、比较不同使用者的调查、随机试验、数项研究的综合，以及不良事件登记。议长只想找出最上等的一份，盖一个‘真’或‘假’的印。
感谢信能提醒人们某种经历值得调查，却没有未使用者作比较；诊所记录更系统，仍可能受选择和自然恢复影响。随机试验更适合估计平均特异效果，却可能人数不足、执行不佳，或没有纳入现实中的老年患者。若问题是罕见伤害、长期使用、实施困难或病人为何拒绝，其他设计反而能提供试验没有的证据。
审稿人先把问题分开：它能否改善哪个结局、对谁、同什么相比、多久、有哪些伤害、能否在本城实施。每份研究按偏倚风险、一致性、精确度、直接性和报告完整度评估，而不是仅凭名称排队。一项做得很差的高位设计，不会自动压过所有做得好的其他证据。
最终结论保留了确定性等级和未解问题。对疗效的把握可能来自多个可靠试验的综合，罕见风险仍依赖登记和监测，患者访谈解释了接受度。新的研究若改变整体证据，决定也会更新。那张桌子没有一座永远适用于所有问题的硬石金字塔。
散会后，议长没有把七份材料按高低叠起。他让书记准备几个抽屉，分别贴上‘疗效’‘伤害’‘适用人群’和‘实施’，再把证据放进它真正回答的抽屉。
explanationParagraphs: A hierarchy of evidence gives different starting weight to evidence according to the specific question and a design's ability to limit bias and support causal or other inference, rather than applying one rigid universal ranking. Final certainty also depends on conduct, consistency, precision, directness, publication bias, and the whole body. Benefit, rare harm, diagnosis, prognosis, experience, and implementation may require different designs.
explanationParagraphsZh: 证据层级按具体问题和研究设计限制偏倚、支持因果或其他推断的能力，给予不同证据不同起始权重，而非僵硬通用排名。最终确定性还取决于执行质量、一致性、精确度、直接性、发表偏倚和整体证据。疗效、罕见伤害、诊断、预后、体验与实施问题可能各自需要不同设计。

articles.fieldTitle: Traditional and complementary medicine and therapy
articles.fieldTitleZh: 传统与补充医学及疗法
articles.title: The Leaves That Did Not Count as Medicine
articles.titleZh: 那包没有被算作药的叶子
articles.summary: A patient brings a complete medicine list to every visit but leaves his daily herbal tea in the kitchen because he never considers a natural plant part of treatment.
articles.summaryZh: 病人每次都带来完整药单，却把每天喝的草叶茶留在厨房，因为他从未把天然植物当成用药的一部分。
storyParagraphs: Mr Du carefully brought his prescription list to every review. A neighbour gave him a bag of leaves said to help sleep, and he brewed them daily without telling his physician: they were a plant and a tea, not a medicine. Weeks later, the effect of a previously stable treatment changed, and both Du and the physician first suspected failure of the prescription itself.

During a complete reconciliation, the pharmacist asked about teas, powders, supplements, and foods, and the leaves entered the consultation table for the first time. Plant constituents can sometimes affect enzymes or transporters, raising or lowering medicine exposure, or add physiological effects. Product identity, concentration, and batch may also vary. Natural origin does not mean lack of activity.

The pharmacist did not declare from a prohibition list that the leaves must be the cause. Much interaction information comes from animal or cellular work, case reports, or theoretical constituents; clinical evidence can be limited or conflicting. The team verified the product and timing, assessed treatment importance and individual risk, and left decisions about stopping, substitution, or monitoring to qualified professionals.

Du neither abruptly stopped his prescription himself nor continued after merely separating the two by several hours. The clinic updated its questions to include herbs, traditional products, non-prescription medicines, and supplements without blame that encouraged concealment. For a suspected event, staff retained the batch identity and followed reporting procedures.
At the next review, Du placed the bag of leaves inside his medicine bag. After checking it, the pharmacist returned it to the consultation table rather than pushing it toward the tea cups.
storyParagraphsZh: 杜先生每次复诊都认真带着处方药单。邻居送他一包草叶，说能帮助睡眠，他便每天泡茶，却没有告诉医生：那是植物，是茶，不是药。几周后，原本稳定的一项治疗效果出现变化，杜先生和医生都先怀疑处方药本身失灵。
药师在完整核对时问到茶、粉、补充剂和食物，草叶才第一次放上诊桌。某些植物成分可能影响代谢酶或转运，使药物暴露升高或降低，也可能在生理作用上叠加；产品身份、浓度和批次又未必稳定。天然来源并不等于没有活性。
但药师也没有从一本禁用清单直接断言这包草叶就是原因。许多相关资料只来自动物、细胞、个案或成分推测，临床证据可能有限且互相矛盾。团队核对产品和时间关系，评估治疗重要性与个体风险，再由合格人员决定是否停用、替代或加强监测。
杜先生没有自行突然停掉处方药，也没有仅把两者错开几小时便继续。诊所更新问诊表，把草药、传统制剂、非处方药和补充剂同处方药一起询问，并避免用责备语气让人隐瞒。发现可疑事件时，还保留批号并按程序报告。
下次复诊，杜先生把那包叶子也装进药袋。药师逐项核对后，把它放回桌面，没有再推到旁边的茶杯区。
explanationParagraphs: Herb-drug interactions occur when a herbal product changes medicine exposure or effects through absorption, metabolism, transport, excretion, or physiological action. Product identity, quality, concentration, dose, timing, individual factors, and the medicine's therapeutic window affect risk. Evidence for many proposed interactions remains limited, so neither assuming natural means safe nor stopping medicines from a generic list is appropriate; complete reconciliation and professional assessment are more reliable.
explanationParagraphsZh: 草药与药物相互作用是草药产品通过影响吸收、代谢、转运、排泄或生理作用，改变药物暴露或效果。产品身份、质量、浓度、剂量、时机、个体与药物治疗窗都会影响风险。许多潜在相互作用证据仍有限，既不能假定天然即安全，也不应照通用禁用表自行停药；完整核对和专业评估更可靠。

articles.fieldTitle: Care of the elderly and of disabled adults
articles.fieldTitleZh: 老年人与残障成人照护
articles.title: The Baker Who Was Not Allowed Up Before Eight
articles.titleZh: 早上八点才准起床的面包师
articles.summary: A care home places everyone on one schedule, while a lifelong baker waits each dawn outside a locked kitchen.
articles.summaryZh: 养老院把所有人安排进同一张作息表，做了一辈子面包的老人却每天在锁着的厨房门外等天亮。
storyParagraphs: Uncle Hu had baked bread for fifty years and woke at four each morning. After moving into a care home, every resident rose at eight, ate at eight-thirty, and bathed on Wednesday. Staff provided carefully but always sent him back to bed to wait. Hu began knocking repeatedly on the locked kitchen door, and the record described 'morning agitation and refusal of routine'.

A new carer asked what mattered in Hu's day before trying to correct his behaviour. He could not remember every date, but knew exactly when dough had risen enough and wanted to bake small rolls for his granddaughter each week. A uniform schedule served institutional efficiency while treating his identity, habits, and remaining abilities as inconvenience.

The team updated the care plan with Hu and his family. Without disrupting necessary treatment or other residents' rest, he could rise earlier, use a safely opened small kitchen, and knead according to ability. Medicines, communication, pain, sleep, and fall risk received individual assessment. Staff offered understandable choices without automatically granting every request or making every life goal for him.

Within weeks, the morning knocking stopped. Hu sometimes still needed more help and the plan changed with his condition. What mattered was coordinated care around this person rather than forcing him into an unchanging service. Professional responsibilities, safety, and resources remained, but shared the same picture with his values and strengths.
One Wednesday, the kitchen light came on at five. Hu slid the first tray of rolls from the oven, and by the eight-thirty breakfast bell, the dining room already smelled of bread.
storyParagraphsZh: 胡叔做了五十年面包，习惯凌晨四点起床。搬进照护院后，所有住户都八点起床、八点半早餐、周三洗澡。工作人员为他准备得周到，却每次都劝他回床上等。胡叔开始反复敲厨房门，护理记录写着‘清晨躁动，不配合作息’。
新来的照护员没有先纠正行为，而是问胡叔一天里什么最重要。胡叔记不清所有日期，却能准确说出面团发到什么程度，也想每周替孙女烤一次小圆面包。统一日程满足了机构效率，却把他的身份、习惯和仍有的能力当成了麻烦。
团队同胡叔和家人更新照护计划：在不影响必要治疗和他人休息的前提下，他可较早起床，使用安全开放的小厨房，并按能力参与和面；药物、沟通、疼痛、睡眠与跌倒风险也个别评估。工作人员提供可理解的选择，不是对每项要求自动答应，也不替他把生活目标全部决定好。
几周后，清晨敲门停止了。胡叔有时仍需更多帮助，计划也随状态变化；重要的是照护围绕这个具体的人协调，而不是要求他适应一套永远不变的服务。工作人员的专业责任、安全和资源仍在，只是同他的价值与优势放进同一张图。
一个星期三清晨，厨房五点亮灯。胡叔把第一盘小圆面包推出烤箱，八点半早餐铃响时，餐厅里已经有了面包香。
explanationParagraphs: Person-centred care aligns support with an individual's values, goals, identity, strengths, communication, relationships, and changing needs and coordinates it across teams. It requires participation, accessible information, decision support, and professional evidence. It is neither a uniform schedule nor unconditional agreement to every request. Safety, resources, and the rights of others are weighed transparently with personal goals.
explanationParagraphsZh: 以人为中心的照护使支持与个体的价值、目标、身份、优势、沟通方式、关系和变化中的需要相一致，并跨团队协调。它要求当事人参与、信息可及、决策支持和专业证据，既不是统一作息，也不是对所有要求无条件同意。安全、资源和他人权利应同个人目标透明权衡。

articles.fieldTitle: Care of the elderly and of disabled adults
articles.fieldTitleZh: 老年人与残障成人照护
articles.title: The Route He Was Never Allowed to Travel Alone
articles.titleZh: 一条永远不让他独自走的路
articles.summary: After one fall, carers forbid an adult man from travelling alone; as a result, he does not visit his sister across town for an entire year.
articles.summaryZh: 照护人员为了避免一次跌倒，禁止成年男子独自乘车，结果他整整一年没有去看住在城另一头的姐姐。
storyParagraphs: Cheng An, an adult with a learning disability, had long taken a bus two stops to his sister's home. After he slipped on a wet platform, the care service required staff accompaniment forever. No further travel incident occurred, but staffing schedules rarely aligned. Cheng did not visit his sister for a year and stopped asking about weekend plans.

A new social worker did not set zero risk as the goal or remove every safeguard immediately. Using accessible pictures, she discussed possible dangers and Cheng's choices, confirming his wishes and providing decision support where needed. His sister, transit staff, and care team distinguished reducible risk, reasonable risk he could choose, and situations that might affect others.

They practised the route outside peak times, prepared a card with address and telephone numbers, agreed to postpone in heavy rain, and rehearsed how to ask for help after missing a stop. Accompaniment reduced gradually, with review and emergency contact retained. Supports matched actual risk instead of assuming that an adult needing assistance had no right to try, make small mistakes, or participate in life.

On his first solo journey, the bus was diverted. Cheng did not arrive as planned, but showed his card and asked the driver to prompt his transfer, reaching his sister twenty minutes late. The journey was imperfect and the plan added diversion information afterward; the small deviation did not become evidence for permanently removing autonomy.
After returning, Cheng placed the ticket beneath a framed photograph beside his bed. In the picture he and his sister sat on the same sofa, with steam still rising from the teapot on the table.
storyParagraphsZh: 程安有学习障碍，过去一直自己乘两站公交去姐姐家。一次雨天在站台滑倒后，照护机构规定他此后必须由员工陪同。机构没有再发生途中事故，员工排班却总凑不上，程安一年没有去过姐姐家，也不再主动问周末安排。
新社工没有把目标写成‘零风险’，也没有直接取消所有保护。她用易懂图片同程安讨论可能的危险和他的选择，确认他能表达意愿并在需要处获得决策支持。姐姐、公交人员和照护团队一起区分可降低的风险、合理承担的风险，以及可能影响他人的情况。
他们先在非高峰时练习路线，准备写有地址和联系电话的卡片，约定大雨改期，并让程安学习错过站时怎样求助。陪同逐步减少，机构保留复核和紧急联系。措施与实际风险相称，而不是因为成年人需要支持，就默认他没有权利尝试、犯小错或参与生活。
第一次独自出发那天，公交临时绕路。程安没有按原计划到站，却拿出卡片请司机提醒换乘，晚了二十分钟抵达。旅程并不完美，支持计划也因此增加了绕路信息；这次小偏差没有被当作永久收回自主的证据。
回程后，程安把车票压在床头相框下。照片里他和姐姐坐在同一张沙发上，桌上那壶茶还冒着热气。
explanationParagraphs: Dignity of risk recognizes that informed and reasonable risk-taking is part of adult autonomy, identity, participation, and growth. Practice requires accessible information, decision support, individualized assessment, and proportionate measures to reduce avoidable harm while respecting legal limits and others' rights. It is neither blanket prohibition in the name of safety nor abandonment of care responsibility; deviations should prompt evidence-based review.
explanationParagraphsZh: 风险尊严承认，知情且合理的风险承担是成年人自主、身份、参与和成长的一部分。实践中应提供可及信息与决策支持，进行个体化评估，并用相称措施降低可避免伤害，同时尊重合法限制和他人权利。它既不是以安全名义全面禁止，也不是放弃照护责任；偏差发生后仍应按证据复核。

articles.fieldTitle: Care of the elderly and of disabled adults
articles.fieldTitleZh: 老年人与残障成人照护
articles.title: The Door Reserved for People Who Needed Help
articles.titleZh: 只有“需要帮助的人”才走的门
articles.summary: A library hides its step-free entrance in an alley and labels it special access; on lecture day, a wheelchair user finds the door blocked by boxes.
articles.summaryZh: 图书馆把无台阶入口藏在后巷并标成特殊通道，演讲当天，轮椅来宾却被堆满纸箱的门挡在外面。
storyParagraphs: The new library had twenty-four steps at its main entrance, which the architect called majestic. A step-free entrance was added later in a rear alley with a sign reading SPECIAL ACCESS: RING BELL. It also served deliveries, so people with prams or walking aids and staff pushing book carts travelled past the refuse room.

For a public lecture, the speaker used a wheelchair. The rear bell was broken and boxes of new books blocked the inside, delaying the event by forty minutes. The director had considered the route a provision for a small minority. A count showed that temporarily injured visitors, older people, delivery workers, parents carrying children, and travellers with luggage all used it, though no one had treated them as one group.

The renovation began at the entrance, making the primary route step-free with easily operated automatic doors and signs that were visually and tactually clear. Service counters had varied heights, lectures offered captions and hearing support, the website worked by keyboard, and quiet areas and varied seating entered the plan. Design no longer served an average person first and sent everyone else to a side door.

No single design could meet every individual need. The library retained assistive technology, reasonable accommodations, human support, and compliance with accessibility standards and invited diverse users to test early plans. Removing common barriers in advance left individual support available for genuinely individual needs instead of repairing foreseeable mistakes one by one.

At reopening, the director removed the SPECIAL ACCESS sign from the rear door. The wheelchair-using speaker and a librarian pushing a book cart entered side by side through the same front door, which closed automatically behind them.
storyParagraphsZh: 新图书馆有一座二十四级正门台阶，建筑师称它庄严。无台阶入口后来补在后巷，门牌写着‘特殊通道，请按铃’。平日那里还兼作收货口，婴儿车、拐杖使用者和推书车的人都得绕过垃圾房。
一次公开演讲，主讲人使用轮椅。后门铃坏了，门内又堆着新书纸箱，活动因此迟到四十分钟。馆长原以为这条通道只服务少数人，清点后才发现临时受伤者、老人、送货员、抱孩子的家长和拖行李的访客都在使用，只是没人把他们算作同一群人。
改造从入口开始，让主要路线无台阶、自动门容易开启，指示同时清楚可见和可触。服务台有不同高度，讲座提供字幕与助听方式，网站可用键盘操作，安静空间和多种座椅也进入规划。设计不是做一个只适合‘平均人’的方案，再把其他人送去侧门。
并非所有个体需要都能由一种设计覆盖。图书馆仍保留辅助技术、合理便利和人工支持，也遵守无障碍标准，并邀请不同使用者在早期测试。提前减少常见障碍，使个别支持能用在真正个别的地方，而不是修补每个可预见错误。
重新开馆时，馆长拆下后门那块‘特殊通道’牌。使用轮椅的主讲人和推着书车的馆员从同一扇正门并肩进去，自动门在他们身后一起合上。
explanationParagraphs: Universal design makes products, environments, services, and programmes usable by the widest possible range of people from the outset, anticipating diversity in ability, age, language, and situation and reducing foreseeable barriers. It is not one universal solution and does not remove accessibility standards, assistive technology, reasonable accommodation, user participation, or individual support. Its value lies in placing inclusion on the main route rather than adding a side door afterward.
explanationParagraphsZh: 通用设计从一开始就让产品、环境、服务和方案在最大可能程度上可由最广泛人群使用，预先考虑能力、年龄、语言和情境的多样性，减少可预见障碍。它不是一个万能方案，也不取消无障碍规范、辅助技术、合理便利、使用者参与或个别支持；其价值在于把包容放进主路径，而非事后补一扇侧门。

articles.fieldTitleZh: 儿童照护与青少年服务
articles.title: A Different Person for Every Cry
articles.summary: Frequent shifts at a temporary care home bring a different adult to every cry; when a toddler stops crying and seeking comfort, staff mistake the silence for adjustment.
articles.summaryZh: 临时照护所每天换班频繁，幼儿后来不再哭也不再求抱，工作人员却把这种安静当成了适应得好。
storyParagraphs: When two-year-old Nono entered temporary care, he cried whenever an unfamiliar person left. A rota placed many well-meaning staff around him, but a different adult fed, settled, and collected him each day. Months later, Nono no longer cried and rarely reached to be held. His record read 'independent, well adjusted', yet he stayed against the playroom wall and would not explore far.

A child psychologist did not assign a fixed personality label or blame one carer. She observed that when Nono needed comfort, responses were not predictable, so he gradually stopped seeking. Without a familiar person who remained available, he could not easily use a carer as a secure place to return after exploring. Silence did not necessarily mean safety.

A small stable group of adults took primary responsibility for daily care and made transitions predictable. They responded sensitively and consistently to distress and approach while allowing Nono to leave and return at his own pace. Important bonds can form with more than one caregiver; continuity, selectivity, and reliability matter more than insisting on only one person.

At first Nono stayed closer to the familiar carer, then gradually moved toward toys and other children. Relationship patterns are influenced by development, culture, adversity, and later support; they are not fixed destiny or a simple score for parent or child. When environments change, security may need rebuilding in new relationships.
One afternoon, Nono walked alone to the sandpit. He looked back once. The familiar carer remained on the same bench. Nono pushed his small spade into the sand and did not retreat to the wall.
storyParagraphsZh: 两岁的诺诺来到临时照护所时，每次陌生人离开都会哭。排班让许多善意的工作人员轮流照料，喂饭、哄睡和接送的人每天不同。几个月后，诺诺不再哭，也很少伸手求抱。记录写着‘独立、适应良好’，可他在游戏室总守着墙边，不敢走远。
儿童心理师没有给孩子贴上固定性格标签，也没有简单责怪某位照护者。她观察到诺诺需要安慰时得不到可预测回应，便逐渐减少寻求；没有熟悉的人留在原处，他也难把照护者当作出发探索后可以回来的安全位置。沉默不一定代表安心。
照护所改为由一小组稳定成人承担主要日常，并让交接可预期。照护者对哭声和靠近作出敏感、一致的回应，同时允许诺诺按自己的速度离开和回来。多名照护者都可能形成重要联结，关键不是只有一个人，而是关系持续、选择性和可依赖。
起初诺诺更加黏着熟悉照护员，随后才逐渐走向玩具和其他孩子。关系模式会受发展、文化、逆境和后来支持影响，不是固定命运，也不能用来给父母或孩子打一个简单分数。若环境改变，安全感也需在新关系中重新建立。
一个下午，诺诺独自走到沙池边。他回头看了一次，熟悉的照护员仍坐在原来那张长椅上。诺诺把小铲插进沙里，没有再退回墙边。
explanationParagraphs: Attachment is an enduring, selective bond through which a child seeks safety and comfort from familiar caregivers under stress and uses them as a secure base for exploration. Its expression emerges from relationships and context, not fixed personality, destiny, or a parental score. Stable, sensitive, predictable response matters, while multiple caregivers, culture, development, adversity, and later support influence its formation and change.
explanationParagraphsZh: 依恋是孩子同熟悉照护者形成的持久、选择性联结，使其在压力时寻求安全与安慰，并把照护者作为探索的安全基地。表现来自关系与情境，不是固定性格、命运或父母评分。稳定、敏感和可预测的回应很重要，多名照护者、文化、发展、逆境及后续支持也会影响形成与变化。

articles.fieldTitleZh: 儿童照护与青少年服务
articles.title: The Secret She Could Not Promise to Keep
articles.summary: A young person asks a centre worker never to tell anyone; an immediate promise would leave him alone with the danger.
articles.summaryZh: 少年请活动中心老师绝不把一件事告诉任何人，老师若立刻答应，反而会把他独自留在危险里。
storyParagraphs: At a weekend activity centre, fourteen-year-old Aze waited until others had left before telling a worker that a coach sent private messages at night and requested locked one-to-one training. He began, 'You must promise not to tell anyone.' The worker wanted to preserve his trust but did not promise what she could not keep. She would listen, share only necessary information with people able to protect him, and explain what would happen next as far as possible.

She did not confront the coach immediately or question other children herself. She recorded Aze's own words and immediate safety needs and followed the centre's procedure to its designated protection lead; any immediate danger would use the lawful emergency route. Aze received support and updates, while information was shared on a need-to-know basis rather than circulating through the office.

Review found that rushed opening had bypassed full recruitment checks, conduct rules were vague, the basement room had no viewing panel, and children did not know where to complain. The problem extended beyond one worker's response to one disclosure. Recruitment, supervision, online contact, transport, spaces, and reporting routes all needed to reduce opportunities for harm in advance.

The centre suspended relevant contact and referred investigation to authorized bodies with due process. It improved safe recruitment, training, behavioural boundaries, and accessible reporting and involved young people in identifying places where speaking felt unsafe. Staff learned to protect and report, not promise absolute secrecy, interrogate children, or decide cases alone.
Before the basement room reopened, workers removed the old door that could be locked from inside. Passing in the corridor, Aze saw a clear glass panel in the new one.
storyParagraphsZh: 周末活动中心里，十四岁的阿泽等到其他人离开，才告诉老师某位教练常在夜里私信他，还要求单独锁门训练。他先说：‘你得保证谁也不告诉。’老师很想保住他的信任，却没有答应做不到的事。她说会认真听，只把必要信息交给能保护他的人，并尽量告诉他接下来会发生什么。
老师没有当场质问教练，也没有自己逐个询问其他孩子。她记录阿泽原话和眼前安全需要，按中心程序联系指定保护负责人；若存在立即危险，则使用法定紧急路径。阿泽得到支持和更新，信息按需要知情原则分享，而不是在办公室里四处流传。
调查还发现，中心为赶开学从未完整核查人员，行为规范模糊，地下训练室没有可视窗，孩子也不知道去哪里投诉。问题不只是一名老师怎样回应一次披露。招聘、监督、线上联系、接送、空间和报告通道都需要预先减少伤害机会。
中心暂停相关人员接触，交由有权限者调查并提供正当程序。它更新安全招募、培训、行为边界和可及报告方式，让孩子参与检查哪些地方让他们不敢说话。工作人员学习保护和报告，而非承诺绝对保密、审问孩子或自行判案。
重开地下训练室前，工人卸下了只能从里面反锁的旧门。阿泽从走廊经过时，看见新门上多了一块透明玻璃。
explanationParagraphs: Safeguarding children and young people is the organized prevention, recognition, reporting, and response to abuse, exploitation, neglect, and other risks of harm. It includes safe recruitment, conduct rules, supervision, accessible reporting, need-to-know confidentiality, child-centred support, and lawful referral. Staff record, protect, and report through procedure rather than promise absolute secrecy or investigate and decide alone; both the child's best interests and due process require protection.
explanationParagraphsZh: 儿童与青少年保护是对虐待、剥削、忽视和其他伤害风险进行有组织的预防、识别、报告与回应。它包括安全招募、行为规范、监督、可及报告、必要知情保密、以孩子为中心的支持和合法转介。工作人员应记录、保护并按程序报告，不承诺绝对保密，也不自行调查或判定；儿童最佳利益与正当程序都需维护。

articles.fieldTitleZh: 儿童照护与青少年服务
articles.title: The Youth Centre Where Every Sign Said No
articles.titleZh: 只写着“不许”的青年中心
articles.summary: A youth centre covers its walls with prohibitions, yet a window is broken on a rainy night because young people have never been given a key or meaningful work there.
articles.summaryZh: 青年中心为防止麻烦贴满禁令，窗户仍在一个雨夜被打破，因为年轻人在那里从未得到一把钥匙或一件正事。
storyParagraphs: Signs at the East District youth centre read NO NOISE, NO PAINTING, NO LOITERING, and NO TOOL ROOM. Adults believed that reducing risk would improve young people. The centre closed at five, leaving fourteen-year-old Xia Chuan and friends outside in the rain. During an argument, a basketball broke a window, and the management board proposed adding bars.

A new director required them to take responsibility for the damage, but also asked what useful work at the centre genuinely needed young people. Xia repaired bicycles, another designed posters, and another knew local older residents. Previous programmes had treated them only as problems awaiting prevention, overlooking ability, relationships, and opportunities to contribute.

An adult-supported youth group helped design opening hours and activities and learned budgeting, repair, communication, and conflict handling. Tool-room access came with training, supervision, and clear boundaries; empowerment did not transfer adult safety responsibility to children. Trauma, poverty, or danger still received specialist support, and no one had to become a leader.

Xia led a weekly bicycle repair table and first repaired the frame of the basketball-damaged window. Young people formed relationships with trusted adults and gained skill and voice through real tasks. The community began seeing them as participants. Prevention remained important but no longer formed the service's only language.
Closing one rainy night, Xia checked the tools, locked the room, and returned its key to the duty box. He passed the repaired window without seeing iron bars.
storyParagraphsZh: 东区青年中心的墙上写满‘不许喧哗、不许涂画、不许逗留、不许进工具房’。成年人认为只要减少风险，年轻人便会变好。可中心下午五点关门，十四岁的夏川和朋友只能在门外躲雨。一次争执中，篮球撞碎了窗户，管理会决定再加铁栏。
新负责人先要求他们承担损坏责任，却也问中心里有什么事真正需要年轻人。夏川会修自行车，另一人擅长画海报，还有人熟悉附近老人。过去的计划只把他们当作等待被预防的问题，没有看见能力、关系和贡献机会。
中心建立由成人支持的青年小组，让成员参与设计开放时间和活动，并学习预算、修理、沟通和冲突处理。工具房有培训、监督和清楚边界，不能因‘赋权’便把安全责任丢给孩子。需要专门支持的创伤、贫困或危险仍得到处理，也不要求每个人都做领袖。
夏川带队开了每周自行车修理桌，先修好被篮球打坏的窗框。年轻人同可信成人建立关系，在真实任务中获得技能和发言权，社区也开始把他们看作参与者。预防问题仍重要，却不再是青年服务唯一的语言。
一个雨夜关门时，夏川检查工具、锁上房门，把钥匙交回值班盒。他走过那扇补好的窗，没有再看到铁栏。
explanationParagraphs: Positive youth development intentionally builds young people's strengths, agency, and contribution through supportive adult relationships, meaningful participation, skill development, safe opportunities, and enabling environments. It treats youth as partners rather than only as risks while retaining adult safeguarding responsibility. It complements prevention and specialist support without denying trauma, inequality, or danger or requiring every young person to succeed in one way.
explanationParagraphsZh: 积极青少年发展通过支持性成人关系、有意义参与、技能培养、安全机会和有利环境，有意识地发展年轻人的优势、能动性与贡献。它把青年视为伙伴而非只是一组风险，同时保留成人的保护责任。该方法补充预防和专门支持，不否认创伤、不平等或危险，也不要求所有青年以同一种方式成功。

articles.title: The Girl Who Was Twenty Minutes Late Every Day
articles.titleZh: 每天迟到二十分钟的女孩
articles.summary: A school treats a girl's lateness as an attitude problem until a social worker walks her morning route and finds childcare and bus timetables trapping her in the same twenty minutes.
articles.summaryZh: 学校把女孩的迟到归为态度问题，直到社工陪她走了一次早晨的路，发现托儿所和公交表把她困在同一段时间里。
storyParagraphs: Fifteen-year-old Lin Kui arrived about twenty minutes late each day. Her teacher made an alarm chart, discussed responsibility, and removed activity points. Lin always promised change and entered after the first lesson again. The school labelled her unmotivated without asking what occurred between home and classroom.

A social worker walked her morning route. Lin's father had not returned from a night shift, so she first took her younger brother to childcare, which opened only at seven-thirty. A recent bus cut meant the next service necessarily reached school late. She also feared that revealing family difficulty would cause her brother to be removed, so she accepted lectures about punctuality. Personal choice existed within family arrangements, institutional schedules, and transport policy.

The plan did not ask Lin only to try harder. School temporarily adjusted first-period registration and offered catch-up time, childcare sought an earlier reception option, transit officials received evidence about the neighbourhood route, and her father discussed shifts with his employer. Lin participated, prepared the night before, and sent a message when conditions changed. Support did not erase her responsibility; it returned responsibility to levels able to act.

Months later, an added early bus made Lin punctual most days. The social worker still followed how peers, school culture, household finances, and policy changes interacted, because improving one problem did not remove every pressure. An explanation stopping at personality would turn many alterable environments into personal defects.

On the first day of the new service, Lin arrived five minutes early. She did not collect a late slip. She removed the six-month-old alarm chart from her bag, folded it, and gave it to the social worker for the file.
storyParagraphsZh: 十五岁的林葵每天迟到约二十分钟。班主任给她制定闹钟表、谈责任、扣活动分，林葵每次都说会改，第二天仍在第一节课后进门。学校把她列为缺乏动机，没人问她从家到教室之间发生了什么。
社工陪她走了一次早晨。父亲的夜班尚未结束，林葵要先送弟弟去七点半才开门的托儿所；原公交线路刚被削减，下一班车到校必然迟到。她也害怕公开家里困难会让弟弟被带走，因此只接受关于守时的训话。个人选择存在，却被家庭安排、机构时间和交通政策共同围住。
方案不只要求林葵更努力。学校暂时调整第一节签到并提供补课，托儿所寻找更早接收办法，交通部门收到该社区的路线证据，父亲也同雇主讨论班次。林葵参与决定，负责前夜准备并在变化时发消息。支持没有抹去她的责任，而是把责任放回能够行动的层次。
几个月后，公交增加了一班早车，林葵多数日子准时。社工仍关注同伴、学校文化、家庭经济和政策变化怎样互相反馈，因为一个问题改善不代表所有压力消失。对人的理解若只停在性格，会把许多可改变的环境误当成个人缺陷。
新班车启用那天，林葵提前五分钟到校。她没有去办公室领取迟到条，只把用了半年的闹钟表从书包夹层抽出，折好交给社工存档。
explanationParagraphs: An ecological systems perspective places a person within interacting family, peer, school, work, community, institutional, policy, and time contexts. It traces risks, resources, and feedback across levels and locates action where it can operate. It does not deny agency or responsibility or blame everything on environment; it explains why individual change alone may be insufficient and how interventions across levels can support or conflict.
explanationParagraphsZh: 生态系统视角把个人置于相互作用的家庭、同伴、学校、工作、社区、机构、政策与时间变化中，追踪各层次的风险、资源和反馈，并把行动放到合适位置。它不否认个人能动性或责任，也不把一切归咎环境；其价值在于解释为什么只改变个人可能不足，以及多层干预如何彼此支持或冲突。

articles.title: The Client Who Missed the Third Session
articles.titleZh: 第三次没有来的来访者
articles.summary: A therapist follows the most suitable manual carefully, but the client disappears before session three because they never agreed what they were trying to solve together.
articles.summaryZh: 咨询师严格执行最合适的手册，来访者却在第三次会谈消失，因为两人从未说清究竟要一起解决什么。
storyParagraphs: Therapist Su Yao prepared a well-supported programme for Meng Chuan's insomnia. She followed the manual, asked its questions, and assigned records. Meng nodded each time but rarely completed the tasks. Su interpreted silence as resistance and explained even more in session two. At the third appointment, his chair remained empty.

When reception contacted him, Meng said the sessions felt like another school lecture. His urgent goal was keeping his night-shift job, and he did not see how the forms helped sleep. A question about family had also crossed a boundary for him, though he had not said so. The technique might fit, but goal, task, and trust had never been genuinely agreed.

Su invited him back specifically to discuss the break and did not defend herself. She acknowledged moving too fast; Meng said he wanted to begin with falling asleep before work. They renegotiated goals, explained the purpose of each task, preserved his right to refuse or modify, and agreed to name discomfort directly. The rupture was addressed and repaired rather than treated as if it had never happened.

Treatment retained structure and professional boundaries instead of becoming friendship. Evidence, competence, consent, and safety did not diminish because the relationship improved. Collaboration helped Meng participate, while Su continued checking agreement on goals, feasibility of tasks, and trust. A good relationship could not replace effective treatment, but allowed treatment to be used together.
At the start of session four, Meng pulled the empty chair away from the wall and nearer the table. He did not sit beside Su; he simply reduced the distance between them.
storyParagraphsZh: 咨询师苏遥为失眠来访者孟川准备了证据充分的方案。她按手册提问、布置记录，孟川每次都点头，却很少完成任务。苏遥把沉默理解成抗拒，第二次会谈又讲得更详细。第三次预约，椅子一直空着。
前台联系后，孟川只说会谈让他觉得自己又在被学校训话。他最急的是保住夜班工作，并不明白那些表格怎样帮助睡眠；一次关于家庭的追问也让他觉得边界被越过，却没有说出来。技术可能合适，双方的目标、任务和信任却从未真正达成。
苏遥邀请他回来专门讨论中断，不为自己辩护。她承认推进过快，孟川也说出希望先改善上班前的入睡。两人重新商定目标、解释每项任务的理由，保留孟川拒绝或修改的权利，并约定不适时直接提出来。关系中的裂痕被说清并修复，而不是假装从未发生。
之后的治疗仍有结构和专业边界，不变成朋友闲聊；证据、能力、同意和安全也没有因关系良好而减少。合作使孟川更愿意参与，苏遥则持续检查目标是否一致、任务是否可行和彼此是否仍有信任。好关系不能独自替代有效治疗，却能让治疗真正被共同使用。
第四次会谈开始时，孟川把原本靠墙的空椅拖近桌边。他没有坐到苏遥旁边，只把两人之间的距离缩短了一点。
explanationParagraphs: A therapeutic alliance consists of shared goals, agreed tasks, and a collaborative bond of trust and respect. It requires continuing review, and misaligned goals, unclear tasks, or relational ruptures can be addressed through acknowledgement and repair. It is not friendship and cannot constitute adequate treatment alone. Competence, evidence, boundaries, consent, and safety remain necessary, while alliance shapes participation, persistence, and how treatment is implemented together.
explanationParagraphsZh: 治疗联盟由共同目标、商定任务以及信任与尊重的合作联结构成。联盟需要持续检查，目标错位、任务不明或关系受伤时，可通过承认和修复恢复合作。它不是友谊，也不能单独构成充分治疗；专业能力、证据、边界、同意与安全仍然必要，但联盟会影响参与、坚持和治疗如何被共同实施。

articles.title: The Man Who Wanted Change Less with Every Lecture
articles.summary: Ren Kai misses his daughter's performance after drinking; the more a counsellor lists harms, the more he defends alcohol as though change belonged to someone else.
articles.summaryZh: 任凯因饮酒错过女儿演出，咨询师越列举危害，他越替酒辩护，仿佛改变是对方想要而不是他自己想要。
storyParagraphs: After drinking caused him to miss his daughter's school performance, Ren Kai came to counselling under family pressure. The first worker listed health, financial, and family consequences and urged immediate abstinence. Ren had arrived ashamed, but under the lecture began defending how alcohol relaxed him with friends and how he was not as bad as others. By the end, change sounded entirely like the counsellor's idea.

The next counsellor neither argued nor pretended alcohol carried no risk. She asked what Ren liked about it and what no longer fit the life he wanted, reflecting carefully that he valued his friendships while not wanting to miss his daughter again. With permission, she offered brief information and asked what it meant to him.

Ren voiced his own reasons for change: remembering weekends, arguing less with his wife, and attending the next performance. He also admitted low confidence. The counsellor did not hide answers in his mouth. She asked when he had previously managed to drink less, what helped, and which small next step he was willing to choose. Direction was clear while the decision remained his.

They recorded Ren's plan and follow-up and discussed likely difficulties. Immediate danger, child protection, or other urgent duties could not be delayed in the name of autonomy, while practical housing, medical, or financial help could not be replaced by a conversation technique. Here the task was to evoke and strengthen his own language for change within a non-emergency choice.

On the night of the next school performance, friends called Ren to the tavern through their message group. He read the invitation at its door, returned the phone to his pocket, and walked toward the school without sending the counsellor a photograph as proof.
storyParagraphsZh: 任凯因饮酒错过女儿的学校演出，被家人催来咨询。第一位工作人员列出健康、金钱和家庭后果，劝他立刻戒掉。任凯本来心里有愧，听到训话后却开始说酒能让他同朋友放松、自己并没有别人严重。会谈结束时，改变听起来全是咨询师的主意。
下一位咨询师没有同他争辩，也没有假装饮酒没有风险。她问任凯喜欢它什么、又有哪些地方已经不合愿望，仔细反映他一边珍惜朋友关系、一边不愿再错过女儿的矛盾。得到允许后，她提供简短信息，再请任凯说这些信息对自己意味着什么。
任凯先说出想改变的理由：记得周末、少同妻子争吵、能去下一场演出。他也坦白信心不高。咨询师没有偷偷把答案塞进他嘴里，而是问过去哪一次少喝曾经做到、有什么帮助、下一小步由他愿意选什么。方向明确，决定权仍属于任凯。
他们定下由任凯提出的计划和复诊方式，并讨论可能困难。若存在即时安全、保护儿童或其他紧急责任，咨询不能用‘尊重自主’来拖延必要行动；实际住房、医疗或经济帮助也不能被谈话技巧替代。这里的工作是在非紧急选择中唤起并加强他自己的改变语言。
下一次学校演出那晚，朋友在酒馆群里叫任凯过去。他站在门口读完消息，把手机放回口袋，转身走向学校，没有给咨询师发一张证明照片。
explanationParagraphs: Motivational interviewing is a collaborative, goal-oriented communication style that uses partnership, acceptance, compassion, and careful listening to explore ambivalence, evoke the person's own reasons for change, and support autonomy. It has direction without argument, manipulation, or deciding for the person and can provide information with permission. It cannot replace emergency protection, practical resources, or other indicated treatment and support.
explanationParagraphsZh: 动机式访谈是一种合作、以目标为导向的沟通方式，通过伙伴关系、接纳、关怀和细致倾听探索矛盾心态，唤起当事人自己的改变理由并支持自主。它有方向但不争辩、操纵或替人决定，可在获得允许后提供信息。它不能替代紧急保护、实际资源或其他有指征的治疗与支持。
